title: Unital derived pullback and tensor squares on K-flat representatives at shift one
statement: Let $f:Z\to Y$ be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Fix derived categories in one localization universe [def-pc-derived-category], the recorded K-flat derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and $L=Lf^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], equipped with its supplied strong monoidal structure. There exist coherent integer-shift structures $s_L$, $s_Y(M)$ and $s_Z(M)$ on $L$ and every tensorRight functor on both schemes. For these structures, $L$ and every tensorRight functor on $Z$ are triangulated. The following four squares are asserted only at $K=Q(P)$, with $P$ a K-flat complex [def-pc-kflat-complex], and only for translation by one: (i) tensorRight(b) for every map $b:M\to N$ on Y, (ii) tensorRight(b) for every such map on Z, (iii) the supplied inverse tensorator $L(K\otimes M)\to L(K)\otimes L(M)$ for every M on Y, with the composite shifts, and (iv) the right-unitor transformation on Y, with the standard identity-functor shift. In each case, for the natural transformation $\tau:F\to G$, the square is $s_F(1)_K;\tau_K[1]=\tau_{K[1]};s_G(1)_K$. No square on arbitrary derived objects or at any other nonzero shift is included.

proof.text: Construct canonical two-variable tensor shifts using the explicit localization construction. Its two-variable structure supplies both tensor-morphism squares by NatTrans.shift_app_comm. Use canonical tensor exactness and the right-unitor representative calculation. Choose the exact pullback shift relative to these canonical tensor shifts and use its degree-one inverse-tensorator square. Combine the witnesses and conjunctions.

proof_origin.place: Explicit canonical shifts; Mathlib two-variable shift naturality; two strictly smaller remaining geometric obligations.

theorem derivedMonoidalPullback_unitalShift_kFlat_one
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)] :
    ∃ (sF : (derivedPullback f).CommShift ℤ)
      (sY : ∀ M : schemeDerivedCategory Y, (tensorRight M).CommShift ℤ)
      (sZ : ∀ M : schemeDerivedCategory Z, (tensorRight M).CommShift ℤ),
      letI := sF
      letI := sY
      letI := sZ
      (derivedPullback f).IsTriangulated ∧
      (∀ M : schemeDerivedCategory Z, (tensorRight M).IsTriangulated) ∧
      (∀ {M N : schemeDerivedCategory Y} (b : M ⟶ N)
        (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ),
        CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) P →
        let K := DerivedCategory.Q.obj P
        let τ := ((curriedTensor (schemeDerivedCategory Y)).flip.map b)
        ((tensorRight M).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app K ≫ (τ.app K)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' =
          τ.app (K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≫ ((tensorRight N).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app K) ∧
      (∀ {M N : schemeDerivedCategory Z} (b : M ⟶ N)
        (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) ℤ),
        CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := Z.sheaf) P →
        let K := DerivedCategory.Q.obj P
        let τ := ((curriedTensor (schemeDerivedCategory Z)).flip.map b)
        ((tensorRight M).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app K ≫ (τ.app K)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' =
          τ.app (K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≫ ((tensorRight N).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app K) ∧
      (∀ (M : schemeDerivedCategory Y)
        (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ),
        CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) P →
        let K := DerivedCategory.Q.obj P
        let τ := ((Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δNatTrans (derivedPullback f)).flipApp M)
        ((tensorRight M ⋙ derivedPullback f).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app K ≫
            (τ.app K)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' =
          τ.app (K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≫
            ((derivedPullback f ⋙ tensorRight ((derivedPullback f).obj M)).commShiftIso
              (1 : ℤ)).hom.app K) ∧
      (∀ P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
        CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) P →
        let K := DerivedCategory.Q.obj P
        let τ := (rightUnitorNatIso (schemeDerivedCategory Y)).hom
        ((tensorRight (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app K ≫
            (τ.app K)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' =
          τ.app (K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≫ ((𝟭 (schemeDerivedCategory Y)).commShiftIso
            (1 : ℤ)).hom.app K)
